Possibly yes. Leafy Plus members get a **90-day** Plant Care Guarantee on plants ordered while the membership was active, so day 60 is within the window if your membership was active when you ordered.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit **at least two photos** (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back. To qualify, the plant needs significant decline, meaning it has lost more than a third of its leaves, has stem or root rot, or has collapsed. If approved, you'll get one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock.

Pests introduced after delivery or deliberate neglect aren't covered. If you'd like help with the plant in the meantime, a Plant Care Specialist can give free advice by chat or email.
